notes:
Searched (Wayback CDX, ~1 req/s): goliathexpedition.com/* (312 html, 91 jpg captures), goliath.mail2web.com/* (456 html, 556 jpg), earthtrekuk.net/* (listed only).
Main source: the JAlbum photo galleries on goliath.mail2web.com/Photos/<gallery>/ (country galleries Argentina, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Colombia, DarienGap, CentralAmerica, Mexico, US, Canada, Alaska; year galleries 1998_99..2005_06/JanFeb) plus Photos/LatestPhotos.asp (Jan-Mar/May 2006 photos).
caption_en = the slide-page 'comment' caption (or the caption text printed under the photo on LatestPhotos.asp), verbatim incl. the source's spelling errors (Vellenar, OTALAVA, Tungurhua, Manley, Peninsular, Laverentiya) and encoding damage ('?The Beast?', 'that day-47C').
CAUTION found: the 2000 gallery's index.html thumbnail titles are shifted by one relative to the images (e.g. index says 016 = 'A midday break' but the image 016.jpg and its slide page show 'dropping into a valley'); captions were therefore taken from slide pages, and a contact sheet was checked visually to confirm captions fit the images. Early (2006) slide pages of the 2000 gallery have no caption; captions appear in 2008 captures.
Image choice: largest archived variant (gallery-root original > slides/*.jpg > thumbs/*.jpg). Many country-gallery photos survive only as ~120 px thumbnails (image_variant says so); full-size versions were never captured.
Every image_url was fetched (HTTP 200, image/jpeg, decoded by PIL) in this session.
Failed / skipped: CentralAmerica gallery photos for Honduras (Campesinos, Sewing - Choluteca), El Salvador (EnteringElSalvador, OnTheRoadElSalvador), Guatemala_1/_2, ReadyToRoll: captions archived but no image captured at any size -> no Honduras photo. Alaska country gallery (Nulato, Toad River etc.): slide pages archived, no images. goliathexpedition.com walk/Photos/* pages: images mostly not archived and the archived ones (Columbia/NIC015-019, Ecuador003) have no caption -> skipped. Drawings and maps in the DarienGap gallery (Karl's sketches, route maps) skipped as not photographs. Pre-walk photos (3 Para 1993, leaving England) skipped. 'A shot taken and used by an Argentinian newspaper' skipped (not expedition photo). Photo '030' captioned 'Colombia, 19th July 2000' skipped (date contradicts route: Karl was in Ecuador). Duplicates across year/country galleries and Latest vs JanFeb were collapsed.
Wikimedia Commons search "Karl Bushby" (files+categories): only File:Goliatexpeditionmap.jpg (a route map, skipped) and Category:Karl Bushby; no expedition photos. Not searched in depth: earthtrekuk.net image pages, blog.goliath.mail2web.com (2007+, outside legs 01-02).
Waypoint matching is conservative: only when the caption names the waypoint's place (or, for 11 Jan 2000 photos, date-only match to w01-088, stated). Date conflicts flagged: BridgeAmerica caption 14 Apr 2001 vs w01-160 2001-04-04; AtBassano 9 Mar 2003 vs w02-039 2003-03-07; Otavalo 3 Sep vs w01-117 2000-09-02.
Latest/33-35 Bering Strait photos may also be covered by a sibling agent's leg-02/03 file (it uses the 2008 LatestPhotos alt-text captions, which are shorter: 'Checking GPS', 'On moving ice').
